architecture_glossary.Kalcypher rung A: Wrap and Register an agent plus harness under a stable identity.
architecture_glossary.Kalcypher rung D: Fork into an isolated Git worktree.
architecture_glossary.L0: Heterogeneous engine adapters and swarm allocation plane.
architecture_glossary.L1: Named agents that wrap heterogeneous engines behind one division identity.
architecture_glossary.L2: Kalcypher uber-harness governance above wrapped agents.
architecture_glossary.L3: Founder-only adoption and promotion authority fixed outside evolution.
architecture_glossary.LX: Cross-layer evolution loop over L0, L1 and L2 configuration while excluding L3.
architecture_glossary.Slot B: Shepherd swarm and population allocation operator that ranks proposals but never dispatches.

definitions.consumer: The first component that should consume the service; this does not grant dispatch authority.
definitions.cordis_coeffect: Read-only environmental context supplied to the organ, such as source snapshot, authority, clock, budget or Trace context.
definitions.cordis_dependency: A reactive service dependency whose availability should mount or unmount the organ.
definitions.falsifier: A concrete condition that refutes behavioral equivalence or dominance.
definitions.reversible_cleanup: Instance-scoped effect cleanup required on unmount; donor and user-owned state is never deleted.
definitions.rollback_point: Exact prior generation or state to restore if the port fails.
definitions.service_definition: A proposed DeepSeek plugin capability contract; it is not installed or activated by this catalog.
definitions.service_provider: The proposed component that supplies the Service Definition.

purpose: Bind every one of the frozen 83 material organs to a content-addressed contract while preserving runtime, promotion, and deployment as separate proof classes.
